subject: Recap & next steps — token volumes, monthly spend bands, and PO gates (Orchard pilot)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@orchardanalytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps — token volumes, monthly spend bands, and PO gates (Orchard pilot)

Alyssa — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can size pricing/commit scenarios and route procurement properly. Please confirm the items below by EOD next Wed (2/25) if possible.

Call recap:
- Use case: customer-facing assistant (chat) + periodic re-ranking and ~embedding index updates for search.
- Estimated steady-state usage (what you shared on call): chat prompts + responses ~120M tokens/month, embeddings indexing traffic ~2M embedding units/month. Bursts expected around reporting (monthly) up to ~200M tokens.
- Target go-live: Q2 pilot (limited rollout) -> broader product usage in Q3.

Sizing bands we usually use for pricing discussions (please indicate which band you expect to align to):
- Band A: 25M–100M tokens / month — target list price: $1,000 / 1M tokens (no commit)
- Band B: 100M–300M tokens / month — target list price: $750 / 1M tokens (quarterly commit discount possible)
- Band C: 300M–800M tokens / month — target list price: $450 / 1M tokens (12mo commit)

Procurement thresholds / typical approval gates we see with customers like Orchard:
- <$20k/month: PO not required in some orgs; credit card or short-term POC invoice accepted.
- $20k–$75k/month: standard PO + Master Services Agreement (MSA) + 30–45 day billing.
- >$75k/month: typically requires legal commercial terms review, SC/infosec sign-off, and finance SLA.

What we need from you to put a concrete quote together:
1) Confirm which sizing band you expect for steady-state (A/B/C) and an expected burst ceiling.
2) Procurement contact and PO process (name, email, internal lead time).
3) Whether a 12-month commit is on the table (we can show step pricing that reduces $/1M with longer commits).

Attachments I’ll share after you confirm the band: redwood_pricing_worksheet.xlsx (illustrative unit economics by band) and a PO template so your procurement team can see required fields.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm band + procurement contact (reply)
- I’ll share a tailored pricing worksheet and a draft MSA / invoice flow for your procurement team to look at
- Schedule a 30-min procurement sync next week if helpful to shorten lead time

Thanks — happy to adjust the bands if you have a preferred structure.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@orchardanalytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchard Analytics Procurement <procurement@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — token volumes, monthly spend bands, and PO gates (Orchard pilot)

Thanks Jonas — helpful write-up. A few clarifications from our side:

- Volume: based on our internal forecast the most likely steady-state is ~120M tokens/mo for chat (so that sits squarely in Band B). Embeddings for indexing are small (2M units) and not a material driver. We do expect monthly spikes up to ~200M during reporting windows.
- Procurement: looping in our procurement team (procurement@orchardanalytics.com) here. Typical internal PO turnaround is ~2–3 weeks once we get a clean invoice + MSA.
- Commit: leadership is open to an annual commit if economic justification is clear. I asked for a target $/1M number — internally they’re looking for a price around $800 / 1M tokens with a 12mo commit. Is that plausible?

Please send the pricing worksheet and a sample invoice/MSA so procurement can review. Also flag any SLA language that would slow procurement (esp. data residency and audit log requirements).

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a procurement call next Tue (2/24) afternoon PT if that works.

Best,
Alyssa
Product Lead, Search & Assist
Alyssa Chen | alyssa.chen@orchardanalytics.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@orchardanalytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Orchard Analytics Procurement <procurement@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — token volumes, monthly spend bands, and PO gates (Orchard pilot)

Alyssa — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and an outline of options so procurement can see tradeoffs:

Pricing options (illustrative; will formalize in the worksheet):
- Option 1 — Band B, no commit: $750 / 1M tokens (list + monthly usage billing).
- Option 2 — Band B, 12mo commit (12x steady-state at 120M/mo = 1.44B tokens/yr): $640 / 1M tokens (volume-tiered; requires 12mo commitment and monthly reporting).
- Option 3 — Band B with upfront prepay (annual prepay): $580 / 1M tokens (prepay required; refunds only as credit).

You asked about $800 / 1M with 12mo — yes, that’s within the range we can accommodate; I’ve included a few better options above that we can explore if leadership prefers stronger discounts tied to firm commit or prepay.

Procurement checklist I’ll attach for their review (see attachments):
- redwood_pricing_worksheet.xlsx — the three scenarios with math (tokens, list price, discounted price, projected monthly billing).
- po_process_template.pdf — our recommended PO fields and sample invoice cadence.

SLA / compliance notes for procurement to flag early:
- Data residency: hosted option stores only ephemeral inference state; for regulated workloads we can stand up Private deployment (VPC) — needs procurement & security sign-off.
- Audit logs: available as an add-on. If you need 3rd-party audits (SOC2 report), we can share our report under NDA.

Next actions I’ll take after you confirm time:
1) Share the worksheet + sample MSA and invoice fields (attached).
2) Join a 30-min procurement sync on Tue 2/24 1:00–1:30pm PT (proposed).
3) If procurement confirms internal PO path, I’ll draft an initial quote and include the preferred commit option.

Let me know if procurement prefers a different cadence; happy to be flexible.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167

(Attachments: redwood_pricing_worksheet.xlsx; po_process_template.pdf)
From: Orchard Analytics Procurement <procurement@orchardanalytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — token volumes, monthly spend bands, and PO gates (Orchard pilot)

Hi Jonas / Alyssa — procurement here. Quick notes on process and what we need to kick off a PO: 

1) Please provide:
   - Formal quote (PDF) that lists the selected pricing option and the billing cadence.
   - Sample invoice showing required invoice fields (we will share an internal PO number once we confirm).
   - Copy of the MSA or redlined summary of any non-standard terms (payment net-30, indemnities, data residency clauses).

2) Internal timing: once we receive the three items above, we typically route for approvals in 10–15 business days for a $20k–$75k/month engagement. If this goes over $75k/month, expect an additional legal review (another ~7–10 business days).

3) PO template: attached is our standard PO template and accounts-payable coordinates. Please send an initial quote referencing our template so we can match fields.

We’re available Tue 2/24 1:00pm PT for a short sync to walk through the invoice/PO flow. If you want to shorten timeline, we can accept a quote + draft MSA under NDA and create a provisional PO number.

Regards,
Orchard Analytics Procurement
procurement@orchardanalytics.com
(Attachment: orchard_po_template.pdf)
